contexts.text: The truth... was not yet so united to good as to be truth from good. But when it was so united to good as to proceed from good... the truth also was then good, because it was the truth of good. (Explained.)
Sarah = the truth of good, which is intellectual truth.
The Lord's Rational is called tender from the Celestial Spiritual, or the truth of good. AC 2184:4.
Truth from good, in the genuine sense, is spiritual good. Explained.
Truth derives its essence from good, and is called truth from good...
Milk = what is spiritual from a celestial origin, or truth from good.
No one can be in genuine conjugial love, unless he is in the good of truth and the truth of good from the Lord.
Isaac = the quality (of the Divine Rational), namely, that it is the good of truth and the truth of good; that is, the Divine marriage as to the Lord's Human.
In order that the truth signified by king might be from good, and thus the truth of good, (the kings were anointed).
Thus a Christian is one who is in truth from good.
When the truth of faith has been received by the will... the man is regenerate; for then truth is of good, or faith is of charity. AC 3175:3.
By light, in the Word, is signified the truth which is from good.
The affection of truth... then becomes the truth of good...
Midian... = those who are in the truth of simple good, and thus allow themselves to be easily persuaded.
Garments like him that treadeth in the wine-vat = the truth of good.
Meal = the truth which is from good, or the Spiritual which is from the Celestial. AC 4335, Explained. AC 4844:12, AC 9198:7.
Hunt me a hunting = the truth of good. AC 3502:end.
Two good kids of the goats = the truths of (domestic) good. AC 3540.
The smell of my son = what is grateful from the truth of good. AC 3575.
Garments, being those of Esau, = the truth of good.

The truth of good is that which is produced in the Natural through the influx of the Rational immediate and mediate. This truth was what was desired; but, as it could not be produced through immediate influx from the good of the Rational, unless at the same time through mediate, that is, through the truth of the Rational... therefore by smelling the smell of his garments is signified the truth of good, that it was perceived. AC 3576, Explained.
Thus truth will become of good.
The smell of a field = the perception of truth from good.
Dew = the truth of good which is from a state of innocence and peace. Illustrated.
Peoples shall bow down to thee = the truths of good, which are spiritual goods, and are called truths relatively; the goods of charity are such truths.
Esau his brother came in from his hunting = the truth of good and its coming... Hunting = the truth which is from good. AC 3594.
The truth of good which is represented by Esau.
(The understanding and the will) make a one when the understanding is of the will, or, what is the same, when truth is of good.
Esau = the truth of good, or the good from which is truth in the Natural. (See AC 3669.)

At first, the truth of good, which is Esau, is not conjoined in the external form with the good of truth, which is Jacob; for the good of truth, relatively to the truth of good, is inverted; but still they are conjoined inmostly, that is, as to ends. Explained. AC 3688:2. Example(s).
The truth of good, which is interior, inflows thus into these acts.
Her clothing is inwrought with gold = the quality of this truth from good.
That all the truths of the good of doctrine should be conjoined with good. Signified, Explained.
Jacob said to them = the truth of good.
Reward, in the supreme sense, = the Divine good of truth and truth of good.
The former (words) = the truth of good; and the latter, the good of truth, both together making the heavenly marriage.
(After regeneration) truth is done from good. This shows what... the truth of good is.
That the truths of good which were mixed with evils and falsities, were separated. Signified, Explained.
The he-goats = the truths of good.
Camels and donkeys = exterior and external truths of good. Explained.
The truths of the good signified by Laban, of what quality they were... Signified, Explained.
Nativity = the truth which is from good; for all truth is horn from good... and it is called truth because it is of good, and because it confirms that from which it is, that is, good.
That no truths of good had been his own, but all given. Signified, Explained.
The truths of good, that of this he took nothing. Signified, Explained.
Rams = truths of good.
They took stones, and made a heap = truths from good. Explained.
The field of Edom = truth from good.
The truths which are from good are those which an acquires after regeneration; for (then) truths proceed from good, since he then perceives and knows from good that they are true.
The truth which is from good is called vir homo, and also the son of man.
The lucid flaming appearance represented truth from good.
That some things from the truth of good should be conjoined. Signified, Explained.
The truths of good are those truths which proceed from good, and which accompany the good that inflows through the internal man into the external.
Horn of unicorn = the power of truth from good.
A company of nations = truths which are from good, or, what is the same, forms of good.
Truths from good are said to be forms of good, because they are nothing else than goods formed. (Continued. See Truth.)
Joseph = the good of truth; and Benjamin, the truth of this good, or the Spiritual of the Celestial. (These together) are the Conjugial in Heaven.

As the truth of good, which is intermediate between celestial good and spiritual truth, was represented by Benjamin, Jerusalem fell to his inheritance; for Jerusalem (then) signified the Church in general.
The principal of the truths of good. Signified. AC 4648:2.
The coat of many colours = the quality of the appearances as to truths from good.
A fragrant odour corresponds to a grateful perception, such as is that of truth from good.
He shall set the sheep on His right hand, but the goats on the left = separation according to truths from good, and falsities from evil.
Adullam was on the boundary of the inheritance of Judah, and hence signified the truth which is from good.
A simulation of truth from good. Signified, Explained.
His brother came out = the truth of good... The truth of good is that truth which is from good, or that faith which is from charity.

Those in the hands, arms, and shoulders, are those who are in power through the truth of faith from good; for they who are in the truth of faith from good are in the power of the Lord; for they attribute all power to Him.
For the Heavens are distinguished into sovereignties according to truths from good.
Clusters = the truth of spiritual good.
Enlightenment... becomes particular in proportion as truths from good are insinuated; for every truth from good shines.
There is no tranquillity until truths from good have been replaced in their order.

Then, as the man suffers himself to be regenerated, there is insinuated by the Lord, through an internal way, the light of truth from good into the Natural, into which light truths are remitted, in order.
Therefore power... is predicated of the Spiritual, namely, of truth from good.
The daughter of the priest of On = the truth of good.
To appropriate the truth of good. Signified.

The medium which Benjamin represents is between... the spiritual and the natural man, and is the truth of good which proceeds from the truth from the Divine which is represented by Joseph. This truth of good is called the Spiritual of the Celestial.
That they separated from themselves the truth of good, in order to conjoin it with this Spiritual from the internal. Signified, Explained.
The truths of good of the exterior Natural. Signified, Explained.
Resin = the truth of good, or truth from good. (Explained.)
The truths of good of the interior Natural. Signified, Explained.
Wax, here aromatic wax, = the truth of good.
Stacte also = truth from good.

For all spices, being sweet-scented, = the truths which are from good, as may be evident from the fact that the truths which are from good are perceived in Heaven as pleasantly as are sweet-scented things (here).

The difference between the good of truth and the truth of good (is this). The truth of good is of the Celestial Church, and the good of truth is of the Spiritual Church. With those who were of the Celestial Church, good was implanted in the (will), and from this good... they had a perception of truth; and hence they had the truth of good... The truth of good is predicated also of the Spiritual Church, but not properly.
To Benjamin he gave three hundred pieces of silver = that the medium had what is full of truth from good. Explained.
(To his father he sent) ten she-donkeys laden with corn and bread = much truth of good, and good of truth. AC 6537.
Corn = the good of truth, but here the truth of good, because from the Internal Celestial. Explained.
An indefinite increase of truths from good. Signified, Explained.
That truth from good shall also be increased, thus the celestial man. Signified, Explained.
The truth of good which is of the celestial man is called truth, but is good. Explained.
Truth from good appears to Spirits and Angels as soft.
A young lion = one who is in power through truth from good.
The sceptre = Power, namely, that of truth from good (which shall not depart from the Celestial Kingdom).

It is said a lawgiver from between his feet in order to signify the Spiritual of the Celestial, or the truth which is from good; for at that time the Spiritual Kingdom was one with the Celestial, but only that which was external of it, and therefore it is said from between his feet, in order that the truth which is from good might be signified... Of this truth it is said that its Power should be removed when Shiloh came. Explained.
The king of the south = truths from good.
The golden candlesticks = the truths of good.
Benjamin = the truth of good of the Spiritual Church.
Sons of Zion = truths from good.
That thence is life to those who are in the truths of good. Signified, Explained.

People, here, = the truth of good, because it is said a great people; for the truth which is from good is great as compared with the truth from which is good; for the former truth, namely, that which is from good, is in itself good, because formed from good; thus is good in its form.

The derivatives of the Voluntary of the Church, which are signified by the sons of Machir, are goods conjoined with truths, thus also truths from good; for the truths which have been derived from good are the forms of good. That the sons of Machir = ... truths from good, is evident from (): From Machir shall descend lawgivers: lawgivers = truths from good.
The consequent implantation and confirmation of truth from good. Treated of.(in .)
That they grew for the most part as to truths from good. Signified, Explained.
That the truths, because they were of good, were preserved. Signified, Explained.
That spiritual life is in truths from good, (or in other words) that spiritual life consists in being in the truths from good which proceed from the Lord. Signified, Explained.
The truth of good which has perception. Signified.
That the truth of good of the Church adjoined the things which are of the Church. Signified, Explained.
A girl = the truth of good which is of the Spiritual Church. Illustrated.
All the words in this verse are predicated of the truths of good which are of the Spiritual Church.
The reason (this) memory-truth prevails... is that the Divine is in all truth from good.
That the truth of good (small cattle) is to be collected. Signified, Explained.
That not anything of the truth of good shall be wanting. Signified, Explained.
Thus the impletion of good for innocence from so many truths of good according to the appropriation of (the proximate good of truth). Signified, Explained.

It is said the truth of good, and thereby is meant the truth which is from good; for those of the Spiritual Church, while being regenerated, are introduced to the good of charity through the truth of faith; but when they have been introduced to it, the truths which are afterwards born from it are called the truths of good.
The blood = the truth of the good of innocence.
The first state of truth from good, in which there is nothing of what is false. Signified, Explained.
Dough = truth from good. Explained.

By their baking the dough which they had brought from Egypt into unleavened cakes, is signified that from the truth of good there was again produced good in which there was nothing of what is false. Explained. AC 7978.
This is the second state of truth from good.
The laws of order are truths which are from good; and the complex of all the laws of order is the Divine truth which proceeds from the Lord's Divine good.
That the Lord delivered from damnation those who were in the good of truth and truth of good. Signified, Explained.

When man is in the good of charity he has been regenerated; and then from that good he begets truths which are called the truths of good. It is these truths, which are the veriest truths of faith, that are meant by the first-born; for the generations or births of truths from good are circumstanced like those of sons and daughters from their parent; afterwards of grandsons and granddaughters; then of great grandsons and great granddaughters; and so on.
Milk is predicated of the truth of good; and honey of the good of truth.
(The pillar of cloud) illuminated the night = the enlightenment of truth from good.

That those in the good of truth and truth of good passed safely through... Signified, Explained... (These words) mean the Spiritual Church; for those who are of this Church are first in the good of truth, and then in the truth of good; for they first do what is good because truth dictates that it must be done... but afterwards they do what is good from affection; and then they see truth from good, and also do it ... and in this case truth, to them, becomes good, because it is of the will... These are men of the internal Church.
Truth from good is of such a nature that it rises to higher things, like a light body in the world.
That all the truth of good proceeds from the Divine Human of the Lord. Signified, Explained.
For truths may proceed from anyone; but truths from good only from the Lord, consequently from those who are in good from the Lord.
The word by which mighty ones is here expressed in the Hebrew, is predicated of those who are in truth from good; and, in the opposite sense, of those who are in falsity from evil.
That thus, without danger of infestation, all will be saved who are in the faculty of receiving the truth of good and the good of truth. Signified, Explained.
The seeds which are the source of new trees are compared to the truths which are from good; or, what is the same, to the faith which is from charity.
Wine = truth from good. AC 8976:end. AC 9139.
All Power in the other life is by means of the truth of faith from good.
That (truth Divine) was without the influx of truth from good from any other source (than the Lord). Signified, Explained.

As the Word is the Divine truth which proceeds from the Divine good, its laws are truths from good. Truths of good are truths which are from good, and which in themselves are goods, because they derive their existere from good.
[The need] of the influx of truth from good from some other source. Signified, Explained. AC 8710.
Princes, here, = truths from good, because they were to be under Moses.
Truths which are intermediate between the truths from good which are in the second degree and those which are in the third. Signified, Explained.
Mount Sinai, in the supreme sense, = the Divine truth from the Divine good; in the internal sense, the truth of faith from good. Explained.
Silver = truth from good.
The son of man = truth from good; in the supreme sense, the Divine truth which proceeds from the Lord.
That the truths of good would perish through the doctrines of falsity from evil. Signified.
A man who does judgment = those who are in truths from good [who were not to be found].
The perception of truths Divine from good. Signified, Explained.

Truths Divine from good here mean all the commandments of the decalogue which were proclaimed from Sinai in the midst of thunders and lightnings... thunders = truths Divine... and lightnings, the brightnesses which are in truths from good.
Divine truths from good through Heaven. Signified, Explained.
As they are only in the faith of the doctrinals of their Church, and not in the corresponding good, thus not in the truth of good... they can be admitted no further into Heaven than the entrance.
That the truths of the New Church are truths from good. Signified.
Spiritual life is to be affected with truths for the sake of good, and to be affected with good from truths; and, Anally, to be affected with truths from good.
Amendment until (good) agrees with the truth of good. Signified, Explained.
Vessels of brass = the exterior truths of faith from good.
King = the truth of good.
A handstaff = the power of truth from good.
Truths from good, and the corresponding scientifics in the memory. Signified, Explained.
Falsities do not stand upright towards Heaven like the truths of good.
They who are in truths from good appear in resplendent garments.
The light of Heaven is the truth of good from the Lord.
That they may appear as truths of good. Signified.
Cedars of Lebanon which he should consume = the truths of good.
When a man has been regenerated, the Lord is present not only in the good with him, but also in the truths which are from good. (Continued. See Truth.)
That truths from good, which are the truths of the Church, are not to be commingled with falsities from evil. Signified, Explained.
That all truths of good and goods of truth are holy, because from the Lord alone. Signified, Explained.
Because these are repugnant to truths from good. Signified, Explained.
That the truths of good are the truths of faith, is because faith is of good, insomuch that it is not possible except where there is good.
All power in the Spiritual World is from the truths which are from good. (Continued. See Truth.)

Those in truths from good are thus confirmed in truths against falsities; and those who are in falsities from evil are confirmed in falsities... for in the other life falsities are removed from those who are in truths from good, and truths from those who are in falsities from evil; and in this way those who are in truths from good are elevated into Heaven, and those who are in falsities from evil sink down into Hell; and, when they are in Hell, they are in terror and consternation at the truths from good in which the Angels are from the Lord. Illustrated.
In the other life all appear clothed according to truths from good. AC 9814.
Fine twined linen = truth from the good which is from a celestial origin.
Spices for the oil of anointing = the internal truths which are of the inaugurating good. AC 9475.
Six branches going out from its sides = all things of truth from good in the complex. ( = the power of truth from good as to all things in the Spiritual Heaven. AC 9561.)
Good is the source of truths; and truths from good are the source of scientifics... but still good is the all in the products and derivatives, because they are from good.

The light in the Second Heaven appears... brilliantly white, the cause of which is that in that Heaven there reigns the truth of faith from the good of charity... Hence by light, in the Word, is signified the truth which is from good; and, in the supreme sense, the Divine truth which proceeds from the Divine good.
What is holy of truth from good. Signified, Explained.
What is full of truth from good. Signified, Explained. AC 9751.
The truth from (this good) as much as is sufficient. Signified, Explained.
Power through truth from good. Signified, Explained. AC 9662. AC 9736.
That this purification is effected through truths from good. Signified.
The things on the left side with man relate to truth from good.
Voice of wings = the truth of faith from good.
Truths from good which fully support the Ultimate Heaven. Signified, Explained.
Spiritual truths, which are truths from good.
All the quality of truths from good. Signified, Explained.
Truths in their order from one good. Signified, Explained.
The foundations of the New Jerusalem = truths from good.
The conjunction of all truths from good. Signified, Explained.
The reason there were four rows of stones, and three in each row, was that there might be represented the conjunction of all truths from one good, and thus perfection.
A beryl = truth from spiritual good, which has power.
A crystal = the truth of faith from good.
Beauty is according to truths from good; that is, according to the truths through which good shines out.

There is a like shining forth (to that in the breastplate) presented inwardly with those who are in truths from good, which dictates, and as it were gives answers, when truth is sought after from the affection of the heart, and is loved as good. Explained.

By the prince () is signified the truth of faith from the good of love, how it enters with Angels in the Heavens, and with men of the Church on earth, and then advances towards the interiors when it has entered by an external way, and towards the exteriors when it has entered by an internal way.
When the stones were anointed with oil, they represented truths from good; and, in the supreme sense, the Divine truth which proceeds from the Divine good.
Weapons were anointed because... truths from good are what prevail against falsities...
Hence it is that in the Ultimate Heaven are those who are in truths of faith from good.
The priests the Levites = those in truths from good.
Fine flour, and meal = the truth which is from good. Illustrated. AC 10105:3.
The truths with those who are in good are truths of good, which are alive.
To sanctify them = that they may be in truths from good from the Lord.
The horns of the altar = the powers of truth from the good of love and of charity. Explained.
That truths from good have all power, and falsities from evil none. Illustrated. HH 539.
That kings were anointed with oil from a horn represented truth from good in its power. Explained.
As all spiritual germination is of truth from good, they formerly made horns budding.
Truth from good not only resides in the memory, but is also inrooted in the life; and may be likened to a flower, tree, or animal, the perfection of which increases towards the interiors.
The representatives which appear around Spirits who are in truths from good. Described.
Purification from evils through the truths of faith which are from the good of love. Signified, Explained. (And through truths which are from the good of innocence. Signified. AC 10210.)
Purifying truths from good which are of the Church. Signified, Explained.
Cassia = interior truth from good.
The sons of Levi = those in truths from good.
Whether you say charity towards the neighbour, or truth from good, it is the same. Explained.
Put ye everyone his sword upon his thigh = truth from good fighting against falsity from evil.
By truth from good is meant a life according to truth; for good is of the life.

The Lord is present with man in his truths which are from good; and the truths which are from good are those which the man wills and thence does; but not those which he understands, and does without willing... For the truths which are from good make the Church with a man, and make Heaven with him; in a word, they cause that the Lord Himself is with him. Explained.
The multiplication and extension of truth from good. Signified, Explained.
The good of faith, in its essence, is truth from good.
The sphere of truth from good which flows from Heaven. Described.
On those who are in truths from good; thus on truths from good. (References to passages.)
Clothed in fine linen, white and clean = those in truths from good.
(Predictions about the New Church) for those who are in truths of wisdom from the good of love. Signified, Explained. AE 6.
He is the Prince of the kings of the earth = from whom is all truth from good in the Church. AE 29.
The Church in Philadelphia = those in truths from good from the Lord.
That to those who are in truths from good from the Lord, Heaven has been opened. Signified, Explained. AR 184.
I will make him a pillar in the temple of My God = that truths from good from the Lord, with those with whom they are, support the Lord's Church in Heaven. Explained.
The number of the sealed... = all who acknowledge the Lord... and are in truths of doctrine from the good of love from Him through the Word.
They are without spot before the throne of God = because they are in truths from good from the Lord. Explained.

As there is a reciprocal conjunction of good and truth, it follows that there is the truth of good, or truth from good; and also the good of truth, or good from truth; the (former) being in the male, and being the masculine principle itself; and the (latter) being in the female, and being the feminine principle itself. CL 90. General article.

That there exists the truth of good, and from this the good of truth; that is to say, truth from good, and good from this truth; and that in these two there has been implanted, from creation, an inclination to conjoin themselves together into a one, (Explained.)

Wisdom from the love of being wise is meant by the truth of good, or by truth from good; and when a man, from this love, has procured for himself wisdom, and loves this wisdom in himself... he then forms a love which is the love of wisdom, and is meant by the good of truth, or the good from that truth.
All that which proceeds from wisdom is called truth; for wisdom... affects its objects with the pleasantness of light; and this pleasantness, while perceived, is truth from good.
Preface. What the truth of good is. (Fully quoted see Truth.)
The wedding garment (which the guest had not on) = truth from good.
The seven Churches = all those in truths from good, or in faith from charity. Explained.
The four-and-twenty elders fell down... = acknowledgement by those who are in truth from good. AE 349.

The word of Jehovah is right = the truth of good; and all His work is done in Truth = the good of truth. The truth of good is the truth which proceeds from good; and the good of truth is the good which is produced through truth. AE 323:6.
The land of Israel = the Church as to truths from good.
The principal and primary of the Church is truth from good. Explained.
Twelve is predicated of truths from good. Illustrated.
There are three things which fully constitute and form each universal essential: the good of love, truth from this good, and the derivative good of life. Representation.
All truth which is from good ought to be appropriated to and conjoined with man; but not truth which is not from good; for this truth has been conjoined with some evil. Signified.

The understanding is opened through truths from good; and not through truths without good; for in proportion as man lives in the good of love and charity, in the same proportion he thinks truths; for truth is the form of good; and all the good with man is of his will, and all the truth of his understanding; and therefore the good of the will presents its form in the understanding...
Under Truth, see this reference. AE 820:4.

The reason (these three were taken on the mount of transfiguration) is that no others than those who are in truths from celestial good can see the Lord in glory; and no others can be enlightened (or illustrated), and in enlightenment perceive the Word.
The production of truth from good, and also of falsity from evil, which is signified by a winepress. (Explained.)
Trinity. 4. 5. The spiritual origin of all human seed is truth from good...
